answer: The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in reef, expire in velvet, and saffron lists each expiry. Someone running 19 aliases therefore needs 47 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3174 identities would post 3322 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
